- **Name and title:** "Dr. Amelia Hart" (`Name`, white) rises into its clipped mask from 1.0s. "Head of Research, Larkspur Labs" (`Title`, soft blue-grey) follows from 1.25s, each over 1s.
- **Hold:** everything sits fully on screen from about 2.3s until 4.8s.
- **Exit:** the text slides up and out of its masks from 5.4s, then the panel and line retract and fade, fully clear by 5.8s.

Everything uses long Cubic In Out eases, with no overshoot or bounce. The lower third sits at the lower left, inside the title-safe area.

I can add a subtle shadow or a thin vertical accent bar on the panel, or shorten the hold to leave more room for the interview footage.
